title: Crispy Courgette Fries
description: A crispy and delicious Italian-inspired snack made with courgette. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Cut the courgette into long, thin strips.
In a shallow dish, mix together the flour and a pinch of salt.
Dredge the courgette strips in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the courgette strips in batches until golden and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain the courgette strips on paper towels.
Serve the crispy courgette fries hot and enjoy!
